key_insight: LungAI refined lung-nodule risk assessment beyond size-based features, reducing cancers assigned to 12-month surveillance by 46% and benign biopsy referrals by 20% in a weighted retrospective analysis.
clinical_relevance: This investigational imaging biomarker could improve screening triage within Lung-RADS v2022; it is not a cancer drug discovery tool.
method: Validated a deep learning malignancy classifier on held-out NLST low-dose CT examinations.
Compared discrimination with Sybil, nodule diameter, volume, and radiologist-assigned Lung-RADS v2022.
Applied prespecified score cutpoints to reclassify examinations along existing Lung-RADS management pathways.
evidence_signal: Among 2,747 examinations from 1,244 patients, including 89 cancers, LungAI achieved AUROC 0.92 (95% CI 0.88–0.95); versus weighted Lung-RADS, AUPRC improved significantly but AUROC did not.
watch_item: LungAI is not FDA-cleared, and triage benefits were estimated from a weighted, cancer-enriched annotated subset rather than demonstrated prospectively.
paper_title: LungAI: An AI Biomarker that Refines Lung-RADS v2022 Triage of Screen-Detected Pulmonary Nodules
